package demo

import kotlin.math.max

/* outer /* nested */ still a comment */
@JvmInline
value class Meters(val value: Double)

data class Point(val x: Int, val y: Int = 0)

sealed interface Shape

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val name: String? = args.firstOrNull()
    var count = 0x1F + 0b101 + 1_000L
    val pi = 3.14f
    val greeting = "Hello, $name! Count: ${count + 1}\n\tTab \u00e9"
    val raw = """
        Raw $name and ${max(1, 2)}
        no \n escape
    """.trimIndent()
    val c = 'x'
    val esc = '\''
    when {
        count > 10 -> println(greeting)
        else -> print(raw)
    }
    val list = listOf(1, 2, 3).map { it * 2 }
    check(list.isNotEmpty()) { "empty" }
    val nothing: Unit = Unit
    if (name == null || c != esc) return
}
